outcome: Developmental quotients (adaptability, gross motor, fine motor, language, social skills)
cohort: The study included 83 preterm infants diagnosed with BPD, 89 preterm infants without BPD, and 98 healthy term infants.
finding: Early intelligence disturbances occurred significantly more frequently in infants with BPD compared to non-BPD infants, and BPD was independently associated with adverse neurological outcomes at 9-12 months of adjusted age in preterm infants.
followup_time: 9-12 months of adjusted age for preterm infants and real age for term infants
